coreMemory.english: aux. used for an imagined or conditional situation；aux. used to make a polite request or express a preference；aux. used to describe a repeated action in the past；aux. used with have to talk about an unreal past result
coreMemory.structure: would like to do something /ˈwʊd ˈlaɪk ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（想要做某事）；would rather do something /ˈwʊd ˈræðɚ ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（宁愿做某事）；would you mind doing something /ˈwʊd ˈjuː ˈmaɪnd ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（你介意做某事吗）；would be better /ˈwʊd ˈbiː ˈbɛtɚ/（会更好）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ would like doing something → ✅ would like to do something；❌ would to would → ✅ would you mind doing something

commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 would + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。
情态动词 would 后面直接接动词原形，不加 to；后面的 something 或 do 要按语境换成真实内容。

coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词

synonyms.difference: used to 侧重“过去常常”。对应的常用英文义是 “used for imagined situations, polite requests, preferences, or past habits”。would 在本卡搭配“would like to do something”中表达“会”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“会”这个义项下，would not（不会；不愿意）与 would 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of would”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。
